ModMetaData.name: Colony Code
ModMetaData.author: Tw1stedGene
ModMetaData.description:
Your Claude Code agents, as remote workers living in your colony.
Colony Code shows the Claude Code sessions and subagents you run on your own machine as pawns in your normal colony. Every powered agent desk brings a friendly remote worker who lives there for good: no food, sleep or recreation needed, and no orders from you. While an agent is busy, a remote worker embodies it, codes at their desk, shows what the agent is doing, and comes to the decision terminal when the agent needs permission or an answer.
How it works: - You run Claude Code yourself, signed in with your own account. The mod never handles logins, API keys or billing. - The Colony Code plugin for Claude Code reports to the game over a local HTTP bridge (127.0.0.1 only, protected by a random token). - From the game you can submit goals, message agents, and answer permission prompts.
The game never runs commands itself. It only shows what Claude Code does and relays your answers.
Not compatible with the Multiplayer mod.
